name: Fluid CRM
description: Fluid CRM is a lightweight visual sales CRM that helps solo founders and small B2B teams manage deals, contacts, follow-ups, reminders, and sales pipelines without enterprise complexity.

events.n: Create or Update Lead and Deal
events.d: Send a lead through POST /api-ingest, creating a deal while automatically creating or updating its contact by email. Supports stage assignment, deal fields, custom fields, and idempotent updates using external.source…
Creates a pipeline deal through POST /api-deals. Use pipeline and stage lookups to populate the required relationship fields and map core sales data.
Updates an existing deal through PATCH /api-deals, covering stage movement, value, status, expected close date, next action, source, notes, and other documented deal fields.
Logs a sales activity through POST /api-activities. Supports core CRM timeline workflows such as calls, emails, meetings, notes, and tasks associated with a deal or contact.
Creates a follow-up reminder through POST /api-reminders, enabling automated next-step and due-date workflows around active opportunities.
List or search contacts with keyword, company, updated-since, and cursor pagination.
Create a contact through POST /api-contacts with core fields and optional company/owner links.
Update an existing contact through PATCH /api-contacts with the fields you provide.
List or search companies with keyword, updated-since, and cursor pagination.
Create a company through POST /api-companies with core fields and optional owner.
Update an existing company through PATCH /api-companies with the fields you provide.
Delete a company in Fluid CRM.
List or search deals in Fluid CRM.
Delete a deal in Fluid CRM.
List or search activities in Fluid CRM.
Complete, snooze or edit the note of a reminder on a selected deal.
Add or remove labels on a selected deal or contact without touching its other labels.
Get deal counts and values per stage, won/lost totals, reminder buckets and record counts.
